verdict.rationale: Docs describe agents that run continuously in sandboxed infra (monday-docs-5,9), scheduled automations (monday-docs-21), event-based triggers like create_item/change_column_value (monday-docs-7,15), and admin oversight of autonomous agent actions (monday-docs-10), all indicating background autonomous execution beyond simple UI-triggered workflows. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that these background automations run reliably at scale, and no third-party corroboration of the agentic automation claims (only first-party docs).
